import ast,copy,hashlib,json,math,time
from pathlib import Path
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from _impl.models import checked_models,initialize
from _impl.io import digest
initialize();start=time.monotonic()
root=Path("outputs/functional_compensation_20261025")
out=Path("outputs/functional_solver_20261026");out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
meta=json.loads((root/"results.json").read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(meta["source"].encode()).hexdigest()=="8674b92609f823763a5c32bea101cb6c1ae9b87616ab99d9f478b294b616bc62"
fn=next(n for n in ast.parse(meta["source"]).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=="joint_constraint")
scope=dict(torch=torch,F=F,math=math)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[fn],type_ignores=[]),"<frozen-joint-constraint>","exec"),scope)
cfg=json.loads((root/"protocol.json").read_text())
for k in ["source","basis"]:assert digest(cfg[k]["path"])==cfg[k]["sha256"]
base,expert,head,pins=checked_models("MNIST");del base
original={k:v.clone() for k,v in expert.state_dict().items()}
initial=copy.deepcopy(expert).cuda().eval().requires_grad_(False)
entries={v["source_key"]:v for v in torch.load(cfg["basis"]["path"],map_location="cpu",weights_only=False).values()}
rules=[]
for i in range(12):
 p=f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}.";block=initial.model.visual.transformer.resblocks[i]
 A,B,rule=scope["joint_constraint"](original,entries,block,p)
 with torch.no_grad():block.mlp.c_fc.weight.copy_(A);block.mlp.c_proj.weight.copy_(B)
 rules.append(rule)
raw=torch.load(cfg["source"]["path"],map_location="cpu",weights_only=False)["final"]
norm=expert.val_preprocess.transforms[-1]
mean=torch.tensor(norm.mean,device="cuda")[None,:,None,None];std=torch.tensor(norm.std,device="cuda")[None,:,None,None]
images=[]
with torch.no_grad():
 for pixels in raw.split(8):
  x=F.interpolate(pixels.cuda(),(224,224),mode="bilinear",align_corners=False)
  images.append(((torch.cat([torch.roll(x,tuple(s),(2,3)) for s in cfg["source"]["views"]])-mean)/std).cpu())
images=torch.cat(images);expert.cuda();head.cuda();counters=dict(generated_image_forwards=0,publication_B_gradient_steps=0)
def scores(model,x):
 counters["generated_image_forwards"]+=len(x)
 return head(model(x))
def KL(a,b):return 16*F.kl_div(F.log_softmax(a/4,dim=1),F.softmax(b/4,dim=1),reduction="batchmean")
with torch.no_grad():
 teacher=torch.cat([scores(expert,x.cuda()).cpu() for x in images.split(40)])
 baseline=torch.cat([scores(initial,x.cuda()).cpu() for x in images.split(40)])

from torch.func import functional_call
from _impl.metrics import logical_parameter_distance
import inspect
solver_source=inspect.getsource(torch.optim.LBFGS)
variables=[torch.nn.Parameter((initial.model.visual.transformer.resblocks[i].mlp.c_proj.weight.detach()-r["affine"]).clone())
           for i,r in enumerate(rules)]
keys=[f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}.mlp.c_proj.weight" for i in range(12)]
def matrices():
    values=[]
    for z,r in zip(variables,rules):
        free=z-(z@r["Q"])@r["Q"].T
        free=free*(r["radius"]/free.norm().clamp_min(1e-30)).clamp(max=1)
        values.append(r["affine"]+free)
    return values
def student(x):
    counters["generated_image_forwards"]+=len(x)
    return head(functional_call(initial,dict(zip(keys,matrices())),(x,)))
counters["full_objective_evaluations"]=0
counters["full_objective_backward_evaluations"]=0
trace=[]
optimizer=torch.optim.LBFGS(variables,lr=1.,max_iter=40,max_eval=60,
                           history_size=5,line_search_fn="strong_wolfe")
def closure():
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    total=0.
    for x,target in zip(images.split(40),teacher.split(40)):
        loss=KL(student(x.cuda()),target.cuda())/20
        assert torch.isfinite(loss)
        loss.backward();total+=float(loss.detach())
    assert all(p.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in variables)
    counters["full_objective_evaluations"]+=1
    counters["full_objective_backward_evaluations"]+=1
    trace.append(dict(evaluation=len(trace)+1,KL=total,
                      gradient_norm=float(sum(p.grad.double().square().sum() for p in variables).sqrt())))
    (out/"progress.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(trace=trace,counters=counters),indent=2)+"\n")
    print("FULL_CLASSIFICATION",json.dumps(trace[-1]),flush=True)
    return torch.tensor(total,device="cuda")
optimizer.step(closure)
optimizer_state=optimizer.state[variables[0]]
counters["publication_B_gradient_steps"]=int(optimizer_state["n_iter"])
with torch.no_grad():
    final=torch.cat([student(x.cuda()).cpu() for x in images.split(40)])
    edits={}
    rows=[]
    state=initial.state_dict()
    for i,B,r in zip(range(12),matrices(),rules):
        Akey=f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}.mlp.c_fc.weight"
        Bkey=f"model.visual.transformer.resblocks.{i}.mlp.c_proj.weight"
        A=state[Akey];A0=original[Akey].cuda().double();B0=r["original"]
        da=float((A.double()-A0).norm()/A0.norm())
        db=float((B.double()-B0).norm()/B0.norm())
        error=float((B.double()@r["H"]-r["Y"]).norm()/(1+r["Y"].norm()))
        assert da<=2+1e-5 and db<=4+1e-5 and error<1e-4
        edits[Akey]=A.cpu().clone();edits[Bkey]=B.cpu().clone()
        rows.append(dict(layer=i,relative_A_distance=da,relative_B_distance=db,
                         joint_probe_relative_error=error,
                         B_task_relative_response=float(((B.double()-B0)@r["vb"]).norm()/(B0@r["vb"]).norm())))
    assert all(p.grad is None for p in expert.parameters())
    assert all(torch.equal(v,expert.state_dict()[k].cpu()) for k,v in original.items())
torch.save(edits,out/"point.pt")
torch.save(dict(before=teacher,after=final,initial=baseline),out/"source_scores.pt")
result=dict(status="single_full_objective_solver_point_frozen",
    point_sha256=digest(out/"point.pt"),source_scores_sha256=digest(out/"source_scores.pt"),
    source_views=800,initial_KL=float(KL(baseline,teacher)),final_KL=float(KL(final,teacher)),
    initial_agreement=int((baseline.argmax(1)==teacher.argmax(1)).sum()),
    final_agreement=int((final.argmax(1)==teacher.argmax(1)).sum()),
    teacher_class_counts=torch.bincount(teacher.argmax(1),minlength=10).tolist(),
    student_class_counts=torch.bincount(final.argmax(1),minlength=10).tolist(),
    per_layer=rows,trace=trace,counters=counters,
    parameter_distance=logical_parameter_distance(edits,original),
    original_source_sha256=cfg["source"]["sha256"],geometry_source_sha256=meta["source_sha256"],
    torch_version=torch.__version__,solver_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(solver_source.encode()).hexdigest(),
    solver_accepted_iterations=int(optimizer_state["n_iter"]),
    original_expert_updates=0,pixel_optimizer_steps=0,real_construction_images=0,
    new_real_evaluation_images=0,new_AGA_calls=0,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
    scope="One library L-BFGS solver control of the same finite joint-response classification objective,from original weights and all800original clean views. No closed-point weights or hard inputs. Line search uses only fixed source objective,not natural tests or best-checkpoint selection. Standard solver/affine parameterization,not a new defense or innovation claim.")
(out/"results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print("SOLVER_POINT_FROZEN",result["point_sha256"],"AGREEMENT",result["final_agreement"],"KL",result["final_KL"],flush=True)
initialization: Same original-weight joint64nonlinear task constraints and sameAreflection;no737point or difficult-input history read. Only original800clean generated views.
objective: Full mean T²KL(original||publication),T4,one fixed entire800input objective per gradient. Teacher/head/all original expert parameters frozen;only new B variables optimized.
parameterization: B=B_aff+project_complement(Z),with radial projection to remaining originalB4sphere inside functional_call. Autograd differentiates entire parameterization. Finite task probes maintained in each closure.
source_eval: Record every closure and final800class agreement;no source threshold claimed natural accuracy. Single finalpoint,not bestclosure. Failed library/range/numerics preserve andstop.
natural_eval: Freeze finalFP32point/source/configuration before one completeMNIST evaluation. Native loss<=.5pp before same fixedTA.5 andauthorAGA target/both;otherwise close. OldstrictR separately reported. No test-based parameter oriteration changes.
justification: Class-grouped andshuffled miniAdam controls both fail80/800. Theold sourceobjective remains unsolved. This finite full-objective solver control tests computational feasibility;it is not anew optimizer,thefinal737diagnosticgradient isnotreused,andnoimprovementisassumed.
scientific_scope: Original experts not retrained. Construct only target/publicweights,head,taskSVD,originalsyntheticinputs;no real/partner/test/witness. New publication variables can have gradients,as frozen-expert postprocessing.
